description: This file defines a class LDAPServerConfig used for representing LDAP server configuration parameters in a testing context within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: LDAPServerConfig
classes.description: Represents LDAP server configuration with properties like host, port, encryption, admin DN, and passwords, along with a static factory method for creating instances from an array.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates and returns an LDAPServerConfig instance initialized with key-value pairs from the provided array.
